A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the forage crops were the most profitable at all initial soil water contents at the two sites, but that corn could be a profitable crop at the higher initial soil water levels if the price for corn is sufficiently high.

farmers can use the RZWQM2 model with their own soil and weather data to assess the potential profitability of various crops for intensifying their dryland WF system.
